name: Regime-Adaptive Multi-Engine Strategy
description: Routes signals to specialized engines based on detected market regime. Uses breakout engine for breakout regimes, trend engine for trending markets, mean_reversion for ranging, etc.

trending_up.notes: Use trend engine for pullback entries in uptrends

trending_down.notes: Use trend engine for pullback entries in downtrends

breakout.notes: Use breakout engine for compression breakouts

ranging.notes: Use mean reversion for range-bound markets

mean_reverting.notes: Use mean reversion for mean-reverting regimes

vol_expansion.notes: Use breakout engine during volatility expansion

vol_contraction.notes: Use mean reversion during low volatility

chaotic.notes: Use liquidity reversal for stop-hunt opportunities

neutral.notes: Default to unified for neutral conditions

forward_test_results.notes: Initial forward test before slim map implementation

activation_instructions.step_2: Load regime rankings with this mapping
activation_instructions.command: python3 scripts/run_live_forward_test.py --tickers US30 NAS100 SPX500 BTCUSD ETHUSD --interval 60 --dynamic
